title: Time Series Methods and Their Applications

questions.question: What is the multiplicative model in time series analysis? a). A model where components are multiplied b). A model where components are added together c). A model that assumes no trend d). A model that ignores seasonality
questions.solution_html: • (a) A model where components are multiplied

questions.question: What is white noise in time series analysis? a). A random signal with no predictable pattern b). A deterministic trend in time series c). A seasonal fluctuation in a dataset d). A type of outlier in statistical data
questions.solution_html: • a) A random signal with no predictable pattern .

questions.solution_html: • (b) To forecast future values based on past data

questions.solution_html: • (b) The statistical properties remain constant over time
